Title: Generally Available: Azure Cosmos DB SDK for Rust

Body.Content:
The Azure Cosmos DB SDK for Rust gives you a native Rust client for building applications on Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL. You get access to database operations directly from Rust, with built-in performance optimizations and failure handling. Efficient binary encoding, automatic retries, and partition-level failover and circuit breaking are enabled by default. These capabilities help you build reliable, high-performance applications with less client configuration and custom recovery logic.  

Learn more.
